items.raw_excerpt: The owner of a charter ferry service says he can't remember a storm this severe on the trail during the month of July, and that there's typically one rain storm in August.
items.summary_en: Heavy rains forced the evacuation of more than 70 hikers from the West Coast Trail in British Columbia. A local ferry owner says this is the most severe July storm he can remember on the trail.
items.summary_ko: 브리티시컬럼비아주 웨스트코스트 트레일에서 폭우로 70여 명의 등산객이 대피했다. 현지 페리 업체 대표는 7월에 이렇게 심한 폭풍은 처음이며, 보통 8월에 한 번 비가 온다고 말했다.
items.title_en: More than 70 hikers evacuated from West Coast Trail amid heavy rains
items.title_ko: 폭우로 웨스트코스트 트레일에서 70여 명 등산객 대피
items.title_original: More than 70 hikers evacuated from West Coast Trail amid heavy rains

items.raw_excerpt: For two years, chronic pain left Jacqueline Tan barely able to leave her room. Small daily steps – and the support of therapy – helped her slowly find joy and reclaim parts of her life despite the pain.
items.summary_en: Jacqueline Tan suffered from chronic pain that left her unable to leave her room for two years. Through small daily steps and therapy, she slowly rebuilt her life and found joy again despite the pain.
items.summary_ko: 재클린 탄은 만성 통증으로 2년 동안 방 밖으로 나가지 못할 정도로 힘든 시간을 보냈다. 작은 일상의 걸음과 치료의 도움으로 천천히 삶을 재건했고, 통증 속에서도 기쁨을 되찾을 수 있었다.
items.title_en: Chronic pain kept her housebound for two years — small steps and therapy helped her recover
items.title_ko: 만성 통증으로 2년간 방에 갇혔던 그녀, 작은 걸음과 치료로 삶을 되찾다
items.title_original: Chronic pain left me housebound and depressed for two years – here’s how I slowly rebuilt my life

items.raw_excerpt: Council officers concluded that the pub did not meet the requirements to be added to the register
items.summary_en: A village pub in North Yorkshire failed to be listed as a community asset. Council officers said the pub did not meet the requirements for the register. The decision means the pub has less protection from future redevelopment.
items.summary_ko: 노스요크셔의 한 시골 펍이 지역 공동체 자산으로 등록되는 데 실패했습니다. 의회 담당관은 이 펍이 등록 요건을 충족하지 못했다고 결론 내렸습니다. 이로 인해 이 펍은 향후 재개발로부터 보호받기 어려워졌습니다.
items.title_en: North Yorkshire village pub fails to become community asset
items.title_ko: 노스요크셔 시골 펍, 공동체 자산 등록 추진 무산
items.title_original: Bid to have North Yorkshire village pub listed as community asset fails - Teesside Live

items.raw_excerpt: From air-conditioned bedrooms to kitchen suites, a mobile road train camp is solving housing on the road while retaining more skilled workers out west.
items.summary_en: Mobile road train camps with air-conditioned bedrooms and kitchen suites are housing roadside workers in outback Australia. The camps help keep skilled workers by giving them comfortable living conditions on the road.
items.summary_ko: 에어컨이 있는 침실과 주방 시설을 갖춘 이동식 로드 트레인 캠프가 호주 아웃백의 도로변 노동자들에게 숙소를 제공하고 있다. 이 캠프는 길 위에서도 편안한 생활을 가능하게 해 숙련 인력의 이탈을 막는 데 도움을 주고 있다.
items.title_en: Tradies swap swags for dongas on wheels to keep workers in the bush

items.title_original: Tradies swap swags for dongas on wheels to retain workers out bush

items.raw_excerpt: People have reported seeing bright flashes of light and hearing thunderous booms as a fireball crossed over the lower North Island.
items.summary_en: People reported bright flashes of light and loud booms as a possible fireball crossed the sky over the lower North Island. Witnesses described seeing the meteor-like object streak across the evening sky. No damage or injuries have been reported.
items.summary_ko: 사람들이 뉴질랜드 북섬 남부 하늘을 가로지르는 불덩이를 목격했다고 신고했습니다. 목격자들은 저녁 하늘을 가로지르는 유성체 같은 물체를 보았다고 설명했습니다. 피해나 부상은 보고되지 않았습니다.
items.title_en: Bright fireball lights up sky over New Zealand's North Island

items.raw_excerpt: O Diário de Coimbra está hoje a percorrer um roteiro pela Região Centro. Acompanhe a viagem pelas redes sociais e no nosso site. Este roteiro de eventos, festas e romarias chegou agora ao Sabugal
items.summary_en: Diário de Coimbra is traveling through the Centro region of Portugal, visiting Sabugal. The route covers local festivals, parties, and pilgrimages in small towns along the way.
items.summary_ko: 코임브라 일간지가 포르투갈 중부 지역을 여행하며 사부갈을 방문하고 있습니다. 이 여정은 작은 마을들의 지역 축제와 행사를 소개합니다.
items.title_en: Newspaper takes readers on a tour through central Portugal's small towns

items.raw_excerpt: Είναι λίγα τα χωριά στην Ήπειρο που καταφέρνουν ακόμη να κρατούν ανοιχτά καφενεία.. Και χρόνο με τον χρόνο γίνονται λιγότερα.. Λιγοστεύουν οι άνθρωποι,
items.summary_en: A traditional coffee shop has reopened in a small village in Epirus, Greece. Few villages in the region still manage to keep their cafes open. Every year there are fewer people, but this reopening gives the village new life.
items.summary_ko: 그리스 에피루스의 한 작은 마을에서 전통 카페가 다시 문을 열었습니다. 이 지역에서 카페를 계속 운영하는 마을은 손에 꼽을 정도로 줄었습니다. 해마다 주민이 줄어드는 가운데, 이번 재오픈이 마을에 새로운 숨결을 불어넣고 있습니다.
items.title_en: When a cafe reopens, a village breathes again

items.raw_excerpt: Cold Storage is "working with suppliers to bring in alternative stocks" while FairPrice is diversifying its sources to bring in "alternative overseas stocks of Marmite" for customers.
items.summary_en: Marmite has been discontinued in Singapore supermarkets because of supply challenges. Cold Storage and FairPrice are working to bring in alternative stocks from other sources for customers.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 슈퍼마켓에서 마마이트가 공급 문제로 판매 중단됐다. 콜드스토리지와 페어프라이스는 다른 경로를 통해 대체 재고를 들여오기 위해 노력하고 있다.
items.title_en: Marmite discontinued in Singapore due to supply challenges
items.title_original: Marmite discontinued in Singapore due to 'supply challenges'

items.raw_excerpt: The first calibration flight on the second runway at Phu Quoc International Airport was completed successfully on July 27 despite heavy rain and reduced visibility, marking a key milestone in the airport's expansion project ahead of APEC 2027.
items.summary_en: The first test flight on the new second runway at Phu Quoc International Airport was completed successfully on July 27 despite heavy rain. The milestone moves forward the airport expansion project, which prepares the island for APEC 2027.
items.summary_ko: 7월 27일 폭우 속에서도 푸꾸옥 국제공항 제2 활주로의 첫 번째 교정 시험 비행이 성공적으로 완료됐다. 이번 이정표는 APEC 2027 정상회의를 앞둔 공항 확장 사업을 한 걸음 더 앞당겼다.
items.title_en: Calibration flight lands safely on Phu Quoc airport's new runway
items.title_ko: 푸꾸옥 국제공항 새 활주로에 시험 비행 성공
items.title_original: First calibration flight successfully completed on Phu Quoc airport's new runway

items.raw_excerpt: Immigration officers deported three foreigners from Bali this month after finding two teaching yoga at a villa and a third installing factory machinery, all on permits that allow only tourism.
items.summary_en: Three foreigners were deported from Bali for working on tourist visas. Two were teaching yoga at a villa, while another was installing factory machinery.
items.summary_ko: 세 명의 외국인이 관광비자만으로 일하다가 발리에서 추방됐다. 두 명은 빌라에서 요가를 가르치고 있었고, 다른 한 명은 공장 기계를 설치 중이었다.
items.title_en: Bali deports foreigners working on tourist visas
items.title_original: Bali deports foreigners for working on tourist visas

items.raw_excerpt: A school in rural upstate New York has puts its plans for a humanoid robot on hold, after concerns were raised about the maker's links to a company that produces sexbots.
items.summary_en: A school in rural upstate New York paused its plan to bring a humanoid robot to campus. Parents raised concerns about the robot maker's ties to a company that makes sex robots.
items.summary_ko: 뉴욕주 북부의 한 시골 학교가 휴머노이드 로봇 도입 계획을 보류했다. 로봇 제조사가 섹스로봇을 만드는 자매회사와 연결되어 있다는 사실에 학부모들이 우려를 제기했기 때문이다.
items.title_en: School pauses humanoid robot plan over sexbot company link

items.title_original: US school pauses humanoid robot plan after link with sexbot company raised

items.raw_excerpt: Prefeito Victor Marques e secretária de educação Cecília Cruz visitaram as obras da creche, que entra na fase final de construção enquanto estudantes retomaram as aulas do segundo semestre nesta segunda-feira (27) O retorno às aulas do segundo semestre letivo na Rede Municipal do Recife, nesta segunda-feira (27), foi marcado por mais um investimento na educação pública da cidade. O prefeito Victor Marques e a secretária de Educação, Cecília Cruz, visitaram as obras de ampliação da Escola Municip
items.summary_en: The mayor of Recife visited construction sites for a new educational complex. The school and daycare expansion is in its final phase as students returned for the second semester. The project is part of the city's investment in public education.
items.summary_ko: 헤시피 시장이 새 교육 단지 공사 현장을 방문했습니다. 학교와 어린이집 증축 공사가 마무리 단계에 접어들었고, 학생들은 2학기 수업을 시작했습니다. 이 사업은 공공 교육 투자의 일환입니다.
items.title_en: Recife announces new educational complex and expands school and daycare

items.title_original: Recife anuncia Complexo Educacional do Pilar e avança com ampliação da escola e da creche - - Blog Dellas

items.raw_excerpt: Ethiopian team disappears after Gothenburg football tournament, boy charged for driving A-tractor at 150 km/hr, and other news from Sweden on Wednesday.
items.summary_en: A boy was charged for driving an A-tractor at 150 kilometers per hour in Sweden. These vehicles are normally limited to 30 km/h and are popular among teenagers.
